subject: Connecting MacBooks to District Network Printers
overview: This instructional session provided Medford Public Schools staff with a step-by-step guide on connecting MacBook devices to networked printers. Peter Cushing also demonstrated how to configure trackpad settings to enable right-click functionality.

items.title: Network Connection Requirements
items.summary: Users must ensure their device is connected to the MPS staff network before attempting to access district printers.

items.title: Accessing Printer Settings
items.summary: The presenter demonstrated how to locate the Printers & Scanners menu through System Preferences or the search function.

items.title: Adding and Removing Printers
items.summary: Instructions were provided on using the plus and minus icons to add specific building photocopiers or remove old printer connections.

items.title: Application Printing Demonstration
items.summary: Cushing walked through selecting a newly added printer within the Google Chrome print dialog and 'See More' menu.

items.title: Trackpad and Secondary Click Configuration
items.summary: The session concluded with instructions on enabling the trackpad's secondary click to mimic the right-click function of a standard PC mouse.
